about:
HC Group Auto Parts Supply operates from Columbia, South Carolina, where it has served the automotive aftermarket since 2005. The business is family-owned and emphasizes its local roots across the Midlands and Lowcountry regions.

The company stocks a complete line of premium aftermarket auto body parts, including bumpers, lighting, mirrors, and related components. It carries the same brands and part numbers distributed by LKQ Keystone, and advertises that its inventory is available for immediate pickup at its Columbia location. Delivery service extends to body shops and repair facilities throughout central and eastern South Carolina, as well as the Augusta, Georgia area.

Primary customers are collision repair centers, auto body shops, and mechanical repair shops in the listed delivery regions — Columbia, Lexington, Cayce, Irmo, West Columbia, Sumter, Florence, Orangeburg, Charleston, and surrounding communities. The supplier positions itself as a local alternative to national distributors, offering stocked parts without wait times.

HC Group highlights several differentiators: family ownership since 2005, a “great price guaranteed” pledge, and access to parts from vendors it describes as the “World’s #1 Bumper Manufacturer” and a top lighting and mirror supplier. The company also notes that many of the parts it sells are made in the USA.
